scripts.test:python: cd site-check && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q
scripts.test:php: cd wp-hardening && composer install --no-interaction --no-progress --quiet && find . -path ./vendor -prune -o -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l > /dev/null && vendor/bin/phpunit
